capture.probe: (() => { const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('canvas')].map((e) => e.getBoundingClientRect()); const d = document.documentElement; return { canvases: c.length, widest: Math.max(0, ...c.map((r) => r.width)), tallest: Math.max(0, ...c.map((r) => r.height)), innerWidth, innerHeight, scrollWidth: d.scrollWidth, scrollHeight: d.scrollHeight }; })()
